data.content: Q3 focused heavily on rapid iteration of the Factorio mod `MRNIU/nzh_factorio_mod`, with 21 commits delivering a series of version bumps from 1.2.0 to 1.4.7 and repeated refactor passes. Major themes included the introduction of a new mining drill entity (`nzh_mining_drill`) and progression work on `level4`, supported by multiple restructuring cycles. Collaboration remained sparse: 2 PRs opened and 2 comments left, but still zero code reviews, continuing the solo-development pattern from the previous quarter. Compared to Q2, which saw 8 commits across 6 repos and a dominant `fix` tag, Q3 shifted from distributed fixes (e.g. `MRNIU/opensbi_interface`) to concentrated feature evolution on a single mod, driving a roughly 2.5× increase in commit volume.
highlights: 21 commits, 2 PRs, 0 reviews, 0 issues, 2 comments, 4 active repos

data.content: 2024 年 9 月工程活动较上月明显转向内核开发，主要精力集中在 Simple-XX/SimpleKernel 仓库，提交了 2 个 PR 并围绕 “working on level4” 持续推进功能迭代。相比 8 月参与 3 个仓库并留有评论，本月仅活跃于 2 个仓库且无 review 或交流记录，显示出更专注的个人开发节奏。上月主导的 MRNIU/nzh_factorio_mod 仓库仅在第一周有 1 个 commit，后续未再跟进，工作主线已切换至 SimpleKernel 的代码合并。

data.content: Two commits on the Factorio mod: "nzh_mining_drill" and "fix long" — truly the Hemingway of commit messages, where every word packs a punch because there are barely any. "fix long" is exactly the kind of message that will haunt you six months from now, when you’re staring at it trying to remember what was too long and why it desperately needed fixing.
